hero: A local repair garage interior: a car on a lift and a second car with its hood open, a tire rack along the wall; through a high window, a wide river and flat boreal land in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#2a2627), accent highlights (#5bfcff), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers.
